assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and transient visual disturbances concerning for transient cerebral ischemic attacks in the setting of known sick sinus syndrome.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management.
The diagnosis codes are G45.9 and I49.5.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is coded with CPT 93229.
The service is medically necessary to evaluate the symptomatic episodes against the documented diagnosis of sick sinus syndrome, consistent with the clinical indication on file.
